mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 34 degrees and clear near the Military Ridge State Trail. The First Quarter moon is visible, and we will see an overnight low of 30 degrees with no rain expected.

City officials are preparing for the December 7th Plan Commission meeting where members will review a site plan and traffic analysis for the new Sub-Zero facility at Liberty Business Park. Additionally, residents are reminded that the Municipal Court is available for handling citations, with options to pay online or via plea sheets.
We currently have no upcoming community events scheduled for the next 30 days, so keep an eye on this space for future updates.

The Verona Police Department reported several incidents this week, including a situation on October 25th where a 40-year-old man was arrested for a first offence O W I after being found at a local intersection.

Today's delicious flavor of the day is Mint Explosion. The Culver's of Verona is currently open but will be closing in 55 minutes, so there is still time to stop by for a treat before they close at 10:00 PM.
